title: NEWEST UPDATE — Ticket Admin Punishment Logging
summary: This is the newest HelpDesk update: `/ticket admin` punishment controls are back and all punishment activity is logged with the rest of the ticket audit trail.
added: `/ticket admin` now keeps the Punish Member option.
`/ticket admin` now keeps the Remove Punishment option.
Punishment and unpunishment actions are logged through Slash Command Activity.
Punishment and unpunishment actions used inside ticket channels also post Ticket Command Activity records inside the ticket.
Ticket creation is logged with channel, customer ID, and category details.
Ticket deletion is logged with channel ID, customer ID, category, and delete reason.
changed: Every slash command continues to post a Slash Command Activity log to the configured log channel.
Commands used inside ticket channels continue to post a Ticket Command Activity record inside that ticket.
Existing claim, unclaim, close, and ticket controls remain protected by the latest guards.
Support instructions keep the corrected Grey R. mention: <@1263248306264608871>.
Ticket and command logging is defensive so logging failures do not block the command itself.
removed: The old standalone `/revoke` command remains removed; use `/ticket admin` punishment controls instead.
